description: All schema changes must be applied via versioned migrations
rationale: Ad-hoc ALTER statements drift schemas across environments

description: Write forward-only, additive migrations; deprecate columns before dropping
rationale: Destructive migrations break old app versions during rolling deploys

description: Add indexes for every column used in WHERE, JOIN, or ORDER BY at scale
rationale: Missing indexes turn queries into full table scans

description: Avoid SELECT * — name the columns you actually need
rationale: SELECT * breaks on schema changes and wastes I/O

description: Always bind parameters — never interpolate user input into SQL
rationale: Interpolation is the classic SQL injection vector

description: Wrap related writes in a transaction with explicit commit/rollback
rationale: Partial writes leave data in inconsistent states

description: Use a bounded connection pool sized to DB max_connections
rationale: Unbounded pools exhaust the server and cause cascading failures

description: Detect and eliminate N+1 queries using eager loading
rationale: N+1 kills performance under concurrent load

description: Declare foreign keys with ON DELETE behavior specified
rationale: FKs enforce referential integrity at the DB layer

description: Prefer NOT NULL with sensible defaults over nullable columns
rationale: Nullable columns explode the state space of application logic

description: Use soft deletes deliberately — they complicate queries and indexes
rationale: Soft delete is not free; every query must filter deleted rows

description: Store timestamps as UTC with timezone-aware types
rationale: Local-time storage causes DST bugs and cross-region confusion

description: Run EXPLAIN on queries over 100ms in production
rationale: EXPLAIN reveals missing indexes and bad join plans

description: Use prepared statements for frequently executed queries
rationale: Prepared statements avoid re-parsing and planning overhead
